summary: Kforce Inc. filed an 8-K announcing adoption of a Rule 10b5-1 stock trading plan to repurchase its common stock under an existing board-authorized share repurchase program. No specific share number, price, or dollar amount was disclosed. Repurchases may begin June 16, 2026, through July 29, 2026, administered by an independent broker subject to price, volume, and timing constraints. The plan signals a commitment to return capital to shareholders via open-market buybacks, providing a floor for the stock without committing to a fixed amount. Watch for quarterly buyback volumes and potential program expansions.
